### 1. Project Overview
- **Project Type:** Business Solution / Enterprise AI Commerce
- **Project Title:** BAKEBOX-AI: Autonomous AI Bakery Assistant & Customer Support
- **Project Slug:** bakebox-choco-ai

#### Description (What We Are)
BAKEBOX is a next-generation, autonomous AI-powered bakery management platform featuring **CHOCO AI** — an intelligent conversational assistant. It serves as the digital and technological extension of our family-owned business, **Shri Ram Baker's**, which has been successfully operating in Mathura for the past 20 years with two established local branches in Holigate and Gosna.

#### Vision
While Shri Ram Baker's has traditionally served local customers through offline channels, we are building BAKEBOX to bridge the gap into the digital era, scaling our operations for online sales, real-time order tracking, and modern inventory management.

---

### 2. Problem We Are Solving (Customer & Business POV)

#### 1. Information Hesitation & Short hardcode Description (Customer POV)

- **Quarry resolution & in-product brief description (Business end) :** Customer quarry like , details about any food item, weight description , quality , quantity ,freshness & any term & condition like replacement are hard to verify from customer end . as of hard to hardcore every description in cards from Business end too . 
  
- **Sweetness & Flavor Guesswork:** Customers frequently wonder about subjective taste profiles — *"Is this overly sweet, balanced, or dark bitter-sweet?"* — but feel awkward calling store staff repeatedly for minor questions.
- **The "Baking Knowledge" Gap:** Shoppers don't know the difference between standard eggless vs. authentic **Khoaa Eggless** bases, custom sizing (0.5kg vs 1kg portions), or fresh baking wait times.

- **Support Drop-off Post-9 PM:** Traditional bakery phone lines close early, leaving late-night celebration planners and midnight craving inquiries completely unassisted.

#### 2. Communication & Operational Bottlenecks (Business POV)
- **Lost Late-Night Conversions:** When human staff goes offline after 9 PM, high-intent customers abandon their carts due to unanswered questions.
- **Support Fatigue:** Kitchen and sales staff spend hours repeatedly answering the same basic questions (*"Is this eggless?", "Kitna meetha hai?", "Reheat kaise karein?"*) instead of focusing on fresh baking and fulfillment.
-**Customize cake:** hard to describe every cake information design & different flavor , base-type availability .  
---

#### 🌟 The BAKEBOX Solution: CHOCO AI as a Digital Master Baker
CHOCO AI bridges this entire communication gap using **IBM Db2 Hybrid RAG & agentic tools **:

- **Instant Food & Ingredient Intelligence:** Customers can freely ask deep questions about ingredients, food quality , quantity , sweetness levels, and sponge textures without judgment or wait times.

- **Contextual Cake Advisory:** Proactively guides celebration planners on ideal weights, flavor pairings, and authentic bases (Khoaa Eggless).

- **Zero-Hallucination Order Tracking:** Provides instant live kitchen baking updates directly from Db2 relational tables (`BB_ORDERS`), keeping customers informed without manual phone calls.

- **Culinary Care Guidelines:** Provides verified post-purchase advisory (e.g., dry tawa patty reheating, storage temperatures, shelf life & storing cake in cold place before cutting etc).

**Target Audience:** Local bakery customers, celebration planners, dietary-conscious buyers, kitchen staff, and store managers.
**24/7 quarry resolution:** provide good quarry resolution & provide real time  order status using agentic tools , & maintain interactive session using Gemini 3.1 flash & provide solution in Preferred language of user .
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 4. IBM Db2 Integration Summary
- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 Community Edition (VS Code Extension Instance `IBMDB201` on Port 50000).
- **How IBM Db2 is Used:** IBM Db2 serves as the single unified data layer — simultaneously acting as a native high-dimensional vector store (via `DB2LlamaVS`) for embedding-based semantic retrieval AND as an ACID relational database housing live customer orders, order line items, and catalog items.
- **Db2 Connectors & Frameworks:** `ibm_db`, `ibm_db_dbi`, `llama-index-vector-stores-db2` (`DB2LlamaVS`).
- **Schema & Data Stored:**
  - `BB_CHUNKS_VECTOR`: Native vector table with `vector(384, FLOAT32)` column for dense semantic embeddings.
  - `BB_ORDERS`: Relational transactional order table (status, total amount, delivery address).
  - `BB_ORDER_ITEMS`: Relational line items (SKU, item name, quantity, base, custom messages).
- **Verification Steps:**
  1. `python submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/src/ingest.py` — Sets up tables and ingests vectors into Db2.
  2. `python submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/src/query_engine.py` — Executes hybrid RRF retrieval and live order lookups.
  3. `python submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/tests/test_retrieval.py` — Runs complete offline unit & integration test suite (9/9 passed).
  4. `python scripts/validate_submission.py submissions/bakebox-choco-ai` — Passes official CI validation checks.

---

### 5. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage
- **Programming Languages:** Python (core submission engine), JavaScript (full-stack storefront).
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** LlamaIndex, `llama-index-vector-stores-db2`, scikit-learn (TF-IDF).
- **AI Models:**
  - **LLM Engine:** Google Gemini 1.5 Flash (`gemini-1.5-flash`) for culturally-rooted bilingual Hinglish responses (with deterministic zero-hallucination offline fallback).
  - **Embedding Model:** Hugging Face `BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` (running locally/freely, 384 dimensions).
- **Where AI is Applied in Workflow:**
  - **3-Channel Hybrid RRF Retrieval:** Combines Db2 native dense vectors + BM25 + TF-IDF via Reciprocal Rank Fusion ($k=60$) for exact flavor and SKU matching.
  - **Intent Classification & Routing:** Dispatches to order tracking (relational SQL) vs cake recommendations (hybrid RAG) vs policy advisory.
  - **Up-to-3 Dynamic Cake Precision:** AI tool outputs structured JSON cards only meeting the `min_rrf_score` threshold (not hardcoding a fixed 3).
  - **Customer Privacy Protection:** Automatically masks phone numbers and addresses during order status lookups to prevent unauthorized data exposure.

---

- **Note on Full-Stack Scope:** In accordance with the IBM Db2 TechX guidelines, the core submission PR contains the self-contained Python LlamaIndex + IBM Db2 RAG Engine in `submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/src/`. The interactive React 18 UI Storefront and FastAPI backend server are demonstrated live in the YouTube Video Demo.

---

### 7. Submission Verification Checklist
Please verify and check every item before requesting review:
- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `bakebox-choco-ai` slug uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/README.md` and `submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [x] **License Declared:** Open-source license (MIT License) is specified in the project README.
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository Code of Conduct.
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/bakebox-choco-ai/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I have submitted this PR URL into the official Google Form.

### 8. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges
#### Dual-Perspective Innovation:
- **Customer Side:** Eliminates information hesitation, provides 24/7 availability (even post-9 PM), deep food knowledge (sweetness level, allergy safety, ingredient breakdown), and bilingual (Hindi + English) interactive responses with rich UI cards.
- **Management & Growth Side:** Acts as a 24/7 autonomous conversion engine with strict session security. Drives sales through smart upselling, cross-selling trending party accessories, and resolving customer inquiries with zero wait times.

#### Key Technical Differentiators:
- **Single Unified IBM Db2 Instance:** Queries across both high-dimensional vector embeddings (`BB_CHUNKS_VECTOR`) and ACID relational transactional tables (`BB_ORDERS`, `BB_ORDER_ITEMS`) within a single database.
- **low-Latency Local Embeddings:** Local generation via `BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` allows offline vectorization without third-party API costs or latency.
- **Multi-Channel RRF Hybrid Search:** Rank-based fusion ($k=60$) combining semantic vector search with BM25 and TF-IDF handles natural descriptive queries, flavor profiles, and exact SKUs.
- **Session-Isolated Buffer Memory:** Dedicated sliding-window context buffer per user prevents cross-session context bleeding.
